correctness.rationale: Twelve H-lines and sixteen B-lines are distinct in any odd characteristic; explicit restriction to the Fermat quartic verifies the contact description and its p3 hyperflex exception. The exact cyclotomic determinant norm census of 3276 line triples has nonzero rational prime support {2,3,5,17}. Excluding p=2, all but 3,5,17 retain generic concurrency. The p5 punctured affine grid gives 16 B-only triples; p17 transitivity gives 48 distinct H-H-B triples; the p3 Hermitian unital yields 63 quadruple tangent intersections. Pair counts total 378. Independent integer norm calculation reproduces all frequencies, and a separately implemented F17 projective incidence count yields the predicted 144/48/15 profile; the source finite-field verifier p3,p5,p7,p17 was semantically inspected.
residual_risks: No assertion in p=2; arithmetic Frobenius vs actual geometric configurations distinguished.
All-prime exclusion depends on exact ring determinant histogram, not just tested finite fields.
